subtext.hi: Similar triangles woh triangles hain jo same shape rakhte hain lekin size alag ho sakta hai — photography se architecture tak har jagah use hota hai!
subtext.en: Similar triangles are triangles with the same shape but possibly different sizes — used everywhere from photography to architecture!

text.hi: Similar triangles ka concept geometry ka sabse important foundation hai.
text.en: The concept of similar triangles is one of the most important foundations in geometry.

content.hi: Do triangles similar hain agar unke corresponding angles equal hain aur corresponding sides proportional hain.
content.en: Two triangles are similar if their corresponding angles are equal and corresponding sides are proportional.

content.hi: Corresponding angles equal: ∠A=∠P, ∠B=∠Q, ∠C=∠R. Corresponding sides proportional: AB/PQ=BC/QR=CA/RP
content.en: Corresponding angles equal: ∠A=∠P, ∠B=∠Q, ∠C=∠R. Corresponding sides proportional: AB/PQ=BC/QR=CA/RP

content.hi: Symbol: ΔABC ~ ΔPQR ('~' similarity ko denote karta hai). Scale Factor = ratio of corresponding sides.
content.en: Symbol: ΔABC ~ ΔPQR ('~' denotes similarity). Scale Factor = ratio of corresponding sides.

content.hi: Congruent (≅): Same shape + same size → sides EQUAL. Similar (~): Same shape + different size → sides PROPORTIONAL. Har congruent triangle similar hota hai (ratio 1:1), lekin har similar triangle congruent nahi hota.
content.en: Congruent (≅): Same shape + same size → sides EQUAL. Similar (~): Same shape + different size → sides PROPORTIONAL. Every congruent triangle is similar (ratio 1:1), but not every similar triangle is congruent.

explanation.content: ΔABC ~ ΔPQR if: ∠A=∠P, ∠B=∠Q, ∠C=∠R  AND  AB/PQ = BC/QR = CA/RP = k

problem.hi: ΔABC and ΔPQR mein, ∠A=60°,∠B=70°,∠C=50° aur ∠P=60°,∠Q=70°,∠R=50°. AB=6cm, PQ=3cm, BC=8cm, QR=4cm. Check karo similar hain ya nahi.
problem.en: In ΔABC and ΔPQR, ∠A=60°,∠B=70°,∠C=50° and ∠P=60°,∠Q=70°,∠R=50°. AB=6cm, PQ=3cm, BC=8cm, QR=4cm. Check if the triangles are similar.

problem.en: ΔABC ~ ΔPQR, AB=5cm, BC=6cm, CA=7cm, PQ=2.5cm. Find QR and RP.

problem.hi: ΔABC ~ ΔPQR. AB=4cm, BC=5cm, CA=6cm, PQ=2cm. QR aur RP nikaalo.
problem.en: ΔABC ~ ΔPQR. AB=4cm, BC=5cm, CA=6cm, PQ=2cm. Find QR and RP.

problem.hi: Ek triangle ke sides 3,4,5 cm hain. Similar triangle ratio 2:1 mein hai. Bade triangle ke sides nikaalo.
problem.en: A triangle's sides are 3,4,5 cm. A similar triangle is in ratio 2:1. Find the larger triangle's sides.

explanation.hi: Congruent triangles same shape+size rakhte hain, isliye similar bhi hote hain (ratio 1:1).
explanation.en: Congruent triangles have the same shape and size, so they're also similar (ratio 1:1).

explanation.hi: '~' similarity ke liye, '≅' congruence ke liye hota hai.
explanation.en: '~' is for similarity, '≅' is for congruence.

question.en: If ΔABC ~ ΔPQR and AB/PQ = 3, then BC/QR = ?

explanation.hi: Similar triangles mein saari sides ka ratio same (scale factor) hota hai.
explanation.en: In similar triangles, all corresponding sides share the same ratio (scale factor).

question.hi: Saare similar triangles congruent hote hain.

explanation.hi: Similar triangles same shape rakhte hain but size alag ho sakta hai — congruent hone ke liye size bhi same hona chahiye.
explanation.en: Similar triangles share the same shape but can differ in size — congruence also requires equal size.

summary.en: You now understand the difference between similar and congruent triangles, and can find missing sides using the scale factor.
